title: Cadence blueprint and OKR-linked roadmap for Private Instances (VPC/On‑Prem)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: Define a repeatable quarterly planning blueprint that directly maps Private/VPC/on‑prem feature deliverables to company OKRs, sprint cadence, and gated acceptance criteria. The outcome should reduce cross-team misalignment during tranche planning, shorten time-to-onboard for enterprise customers, and provide a measurable signal for readiness (SLA attainment, upgrade success rate).
goals: 1) Create a template that links each roadmap item to at least one OKR metric and acceptance metric. 2) Lock a predictable two-month cadence for plan->deliver->verify for private deployments. 3) Standardize compatibility and upgrade gates so customers can self-service a predictable upgrade window. 4) Reduce cross-functional review cycles by 30% via pre-filled artifacts (compat matrix, KB sweep, security checklist).
success_metrics:
- <10% drift between planned and delivered features per quarter
- Customer onboarding time for private instances reduced from median 18 days to <12 days
- Upgrade failure rate under 2% across staged rollouts
- 95% of roadmap items have linked OKR and acceptance criteria before cycle start
scope_included: Roadmap template, sprint bucket definitions, OKR mapping doc, readiness gates (compatibility matrix, infra checklist, security checklist), stakeholder cadence (weekly syncs), playbook for wave cutovers, telemetry signal spec (onboarding time, upgrade success).
scope_excluded: Implementation work for individual features (engineers will track in ENG tickets), billing/contract changes to pricing, direct sales enablement collateral beyond one-pager handoff.
milestones:
- 2026-01-24: Draft cadence blueprint and OKR mapping template complete
- 2026-02-07: Cross-functional review (Eng/SRE/Sales/Legal) done
- 2026-02-21: Pilot the template with 2 upcoming private deployment features (canary plan)
- 2026-03-07: Update template from pilot feedback and lock cadence
- 2026-03-21: Publish runbook and handoff to program managers
- 2026-04-15: Verify metrics from first closed cycle and iterate
timeline: We’re operating on a 10-week ramp: research (2w), draft (2w), pilot (2w), iterate (2w), publish & verify (2w). Key syncs happen weekly on Fridays with release owners.
acceptance_criteria:
- Template exists in Confluence with 1:1 mapping to OKRs and measurable acceptance criteria for each roadmap item
- Pilot features (2) completed using the cadence with documented evidence (dashboard links)
- SRE and Security approve the readiness gates and checklist
- PMO confirms reduced review cycle time in trial run
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: Engineering bandwidth constraints delay pilots. Mitigation: scope pilot to two low-effort features and defer heavy integrations.
- Risk: Misaligned definitions of 'upgrade success' across teams. Mitigation: convene a metrics working group to finalize definitions in week 1.
- Risk: Customer expectations mismatch around upgrade windows. Mitigation: include a customer-facing FAQ and standard SLA language in the runbook.
